title: Photonics Fundamentals For Electronics Engineers: eBook
gist: Semiconductor Engineering's photonics eBook argues AI has created a data-movement crisis in the data center and that the moment for photons to replace electrons for data transfer has arrived, with optics migrating from rack-to-rack links toward the package and eventually near compute.

insights.claim: AI has created a crisis in the data center because compute and memory density have grown far beyond expectations while moving data between processors and memory quickly and efficiently remains unsolved.
insights.speaker: Bryon Moyer
insights.so_what: Interconnect/data-movement is the binding constraint, steering capex toward bandwidth and interconnect suppliers.
insights.quote: AI has created a crisis in the data center.

insights.claim: The author argues the long-anticipated point at which photons become the better choice than electrons over wires for moving data has now arrived.
insights.speaker: Bryon Moyer
insights.so_what: Signals an inflection in optical interconnect adoption that benefits photonics and optical component vendors.
insights.locator: While the chip industry was built

insights.claim: Optical data movement has so far focused on server-to-server links within a rack and rack-to-rack links, but optical signals will move to the package level and eventually much closer to where data is processed.
insights.speaker: Bryon Moyer
insights.so_what: Implies a roadmap from pluggable optics to co-packaged and in-package optics, expanding the addressable market for photonic packaging.
insights.quote: in the future optical signals will move to the package level, and eventually much closer to where data is actually processed
insights.locator: Many elements and technologies are required

insights.claim: Practical photonics is far harder than theory: harnessing light, protecting signals from noise, and electrical-optical-electrical conversion were recently considered science fiction, and just plugging optical cables into racks was revolutionary a decade ago.
insights.speaker: Bryon Moyer
insights.so_what: Execution complexity creates moats for firms with proven photonic design, packaging and test capability.
insights.quote: what sounds good in theory has proved to be far more complicated in practice
insights.locator: Still, what sounds good in theory

insights.claim: The eBook's technical advisory board spans EDA vendors (Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens EDA), test and measurement (Keysight Technologies, Advantest, YieldWerx), optical I/O startup Ayar Labs and materials supplier Brewer Science, indicating the breadth of the photonics design supply chain.
insights.speaker: Bryon Moyer
insights.so_what: Maps which EDA, test and materials vendors are positioning around photonics design flows.

insights.claim: Photonics design topics flagged in the coverage include lasers, laser diodes, photodiodes, waveguides, ring resonators, edge and grating coupling, photonic test and photonic security.
insights.speaker: Bryon Moyer
insights.so_what: Identifies component sub-markets that must scale for optical interconnect adoption.
